description: This Go source file defines tools and metadata for GitHub integrations, including toolset definitions, helper functions for tool metadata, and functions for managing toolset configurations and help text.

classes.name: ToolsetMetadata
classes.description: Type alias for toolsets.ToolsetMetadata, representing metadata for a toolset.

methods.name: NewToolMeta
methods.description: Creates tool metadata with specified toolset and scopes, returning an mcp.Meta object.

methods.name: NewResourceMeta
methods.description: Creates resource template metadata for a given toolset.

methods.name: NewPromptMeta
methods.description: Creates prompt metadata for a given toolset.

methods.name: AvailableToolsets
methods.description: Returns a list of all available toolset metadata objects.

methods.name: GetValidToolsetIDs
methods.description: Returns a map of valid toolset IDs for quick lookup.

methods.name: GetDefaultToolsetIDs
methods.description: Returns a list of default toolset IDs.

methods.name: NewDefaultToolsetRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry with all available GitHub tools, resource templates, and prompts.

methods.name: DefaultToolsetGroup
methods.description: Creates a default toolset group with optional read-only mode.

methods.name: InitDynamicToolset
methods.description: Creates a dynamic toolset for enabling other toolsets, requiring server and toolset group.

methods.name: ToBoolPtr
methods.description: Converts a bool to a *bool pointer.

methods.name: ToStringPtr
methods.description: Converts a string to a *string pointer, nil if empty.

methods.name: GenerateToolsetsHelp
methods.description: Generates help text for the toolsets flag, including available options and examples.

methods.name: AddDefaultToolset
methods.description: Replaces 'default' keyword with actual default toolset IDs.

methods.name: CleanToolsets
methods.description: Removes duplicates, trims whitespace, validates toolset names, and separates invalid entries.

methods.name: RemoveToolset
methods.description: Removes a specific toolset from a list.

methods.name: ContainsToolset
methods.description: Checks if a list contains a specific toolset.

methods.name: CleanTools
methods.description: Removes duplicates and trims whitespace from tool names.
